thread:
Ethan (Acme Integrations): Hey team — we're seeing truncated SSE responses from the Redwood API when our client does a resume after a disconnect. The last chunk never arrives and the JSON is incomplete (missing closing `]` and no `finish_reason`). Happening reliably when we send Last-Event-ID to resume.

Maya (Support): sorry to hear that — can you paste your repro curl command and the raw response? also which region / model & any headers you set?

Ethan (Acme Integrations): repro below. region: us-west-2, model: redwood-open-7b, streaming via SSE. headers: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, `Accept: text/event-stream`, we set `Last-Event-ID` with the last id we received.

```
> curl -v -N \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Last-Event-ID: evt_456" \
  "https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/streams/generate?model=redwood-open-7b"\n```

Raw tail of the stream we get after reconnect: (we trimmed earlier chunks)

```
event: message
data: {"id":"evt_457","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...chunk..."}}]}

event: message
data: {"id":"evt_458","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...more..."}}]}

event: message
data: {"id":"evt_459","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"final piece"}}]



```

Note: the last data event above is missing the closing `}` and `]` and we don't receive any `event: done` or `finish_reason`.

Maya (Support): thanks — looks like the resume combined fragments incorrectly. can you confirm if you see duplicate prefix tokens (evt_456 re-sent) or overlapping offsets? also what's your client: custom SSE or a lib?

Ethan (Acme Integrations): custom Node SSE handler using `eventsource` polyfill. We do dedupe by `Last-Event-ID` but we only ignore exact ids; if the server re-emits a fragment with the same id but truncated chunk it's causing incomplete JSON on concat.

Rosa (Oncall): adding oncall/runtime. @Kunal can you look? this smells like a resume/concat logic bug in the stream gateway where resumed fragments are appended without ensuring event boundaries. Seen it before w/ buffering edgecases.

Kunal (Runtime): I'll repro locally — thanks for curl and raw tail. Quick hypothesis: when resume header triggers partial retransmit, the server might send the trailing bytes as a new data event but client-side concatenation treats it as continuation of prior data event — results in malformed JSON. Need to check server-side event framing and also how `Last-Event-ID` is used to determine resume offset.

Maya (Support): workaround for customer: avoid using resume header for now (reconnect without Last-Event-ID so app restarts output), or add a validation step: only accept events that parse as complete JSON and request a fresh generate on parse failure. Does that work for you in short-term @Ethan?

Ethan (Acme Integrations): we can do that as a stopgap. prefer server fix though — this breaks our edge-case reconnection.

Kunal (Runtime): I tried a repro with the same sequence and saw the gateway emitting `data:` lines that included partial JSON fragments across events when resume is engaged. Logs show resume path picks up last seen offset but doesn't atomically re-emit whole logical messages — it replays raw fragments. I'll open a patch to coalesce fragments server-side before emitting.

Kunal (Runtime): attaching quick log excerpt:

```
[2026-02-28T14:03:12Z] resume request evt_id=evt_456 from client ip=1.2.3.4
[2026-02-28T14:03:12Z] replaying fragments: frag(455, bytes=512), frag(456, bytes=200), frag(457, bytes=128)
[2026-02-28T14:03:12Z] emitting fragment as separate events due to flush boundaries
```

Kunal (Runtime): root cause: replay emits fragment-level chunks; client expects message-level `data:` events to be complete JSON blobs. Fix path: coalesce replay fragments into full message buffers before sending; also add integrity check so resume cannot emit half a JSON data event.

Maya (Support): estimate for fix? customer needs ETA so they can plan.

Kunal (Runtime): will create PR today, aim to patch gateway and release hotfix to staging within 24h, production rollout if staging green in ~48h. Also adding test for resume with partial fragment boundaries.

Ethan (Acme Integrations): appreciated. any interim headers we can set to avoid the resume path on your side besides not sending `Last-Event-ID`?

Kunal (Runtime): you can set `X-Stream-Strict: 1` to tell gateway to avoid fragment replay behavior (server will disconnect instead of resuming) — that'll force a fresh session. Not documented publically, so use it with caution; I'll cc account team if you want us to enable on your account until fix is live.

Maya (Support): cc'ing account ops. @deploy-bot please create ticket for enablement flag for customer and track SLA.

deploy-bot: created ticket RED-7890, assigned to infra-ops, ETA 2 business days. :white_check_mark:

Rosa (Oncall): I've added a monitoring alert to catch malformed JSON emissions on resume paths — will surface if this regresses.

Kunal (Runtime): PR link: https://github.com/redwoodinference/gateway/pull/2123 (draft). I'll push tests and request a review from @Rosa.

Maya (Support): thank you all. Ethan — I'll keep this thread updated with staging/production rollout notes and the temporary enablement ticket. Apologies for the disruption. :pray: 

Ethan (Acme Integrations): thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround. we'll apply the `X-Stream-Strict` workaround in the meantime and let you know if anything else shows up.

Kunal (Runtime): Quick note for the logs team — add a short-lived field `resume_trace_id` to correlate replay fragments with client `Last-Event-ID` so we can debug similar cases faster.

Maya (Support): noted. closing loop once prod rollout done.
